About Me

I'm a Business Information Systems student at Al-Obour Institute, and data analysis is where I've chosen to focus my energy. I like the process — pulling a messy, inconsistent dataset into shape, then building something out of it that actually helps someone make a decision.

My toolkit right now is Excel, Power BI, SQL, and Python. I'm early in this path, but every project I take on is built the same way: clean the data properly first, then let the analysis speak for itself.

What I Do

Data Analysis & Insights
